question: Should OpenClaw support default-off WebChat-to-last-external mirroring as its own session policy, fold it into the broader origin-channel delivery policy, or keep WebChat isolated from external routes?
rationale: The requested behavior intentionally duplicates internal Control UI output into an external conversation selected from persisted session route state, so code inspection cannot safely choose the product and privacy boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add Explicit Opt-In Mirroring
options.body: Implement a default-off session policy with route freshness, authorization, duplicate-delivery protection, failure logging, schema/docs, and live Discord or Telegram proof.

options.title: Fold Into Origin Delivery Policy
options.body: Keep this issue as the WebChat scenario while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/54531 defines one durable origin-channel delivery model.

options.title: Keep WebChat Isolated
options.body: Document explicit sends or channel-docking workflows as the supported bridge and avoid automatic mirroring from WebChat to external channels.

recommendation.title: Add Explicit Opt-In Mirroring
recommendation.body: Implement a default-off session policy with route freshness, authorization, duplicate-delivery protection, failure logging, schema/docs, and live Discord or Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to this issue and has the strongest current-main provenance on the WebChat routing gates and scope clarification.
